steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Generate base structure for Paint Master Studio including core build configs and manifest configurations.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle
steps.description: Define compiler settings matching the requested AGP 8.3.2, SDK 34, and Java 8 targeting constraints.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare default launch activity and set storage permissions for saving drawn artwork.

steps.title: Create App Meta File
steps.description: Generate general metadata matching package structures.

steps.title: Develop Drawing Engine (DrawingView.java)
steps.description: Create a hardware-accelerated View that maps touch motions into real-time canvas paths.

steps.title: Implement Vector Paint Actions
steps.description: Configure drawing elements with distinct paint paths, strokes, colors, and shape properties.

steps.title: Build Live Canvas Previews
steps.description: Ensure that resizing lines, circles, and rectangles draw real-time interactive previews during swipe actions.

steps.title: Code Undo & Redo Mechanisms
steps.description: Enable non-destructive editing history stacks to back-traverse or restore user brush strokes dynamically.

steps.title: Program PorterDuff Eraser Engine
steps.description: Utilize pixel clearing xfermodes for natural freeform eraser capability across drawing vectors.

steps.title: Design Layout Architecture
steps.description: Draft a structured UI layout hosting the DrawingView alongside complete layout control decks.

steps.title: Create Action Control Decks
steps.description: Assemble responsive UI headers for immediate undo, redo, clear, and safe-saving utilities.

steps.title: Draft Dynamic Styling Controls
steps.description: Set up interactive size SeekBars, tool buttons, color scrollbars, and active state highlights.

steps.title: Wire Core Logic in MainActivity
steps.description: Formulate the central paint controllers, linking seekbars, active layouts, color-state clicks, and drawing models.

steps.title: Assemble MediaStore Export Pipeline
steps.description: Integrate full storage saving logic targeting Android media-scanners safely across SDK iterations.

steps.title: Implement Canvas BG Modifiers
steps.description: Incorporate interactive toggles to cycle board backgrounds dynamically while preserving drawing lists.

steps.title: Validate Quality & Java 8 Compliance
steps.description: Assure anonymous execution loops are used uniformly instead of unsupported lambdas or advanced streams.

steps.title: Building Paint Master Studio
steps.description: Synthesize the structural assets, views, configurations, and compile the final painting framework output.
